reviewer: Independent AI subagent; direct inspection of four actual native PNGs
observations: At 320 by 568, all six primary image/word cards remain within the screen. The compact payment reader appears as a yellow low body, white keypad, separate blue bank card and projecting receipt; it remains fully visible at approximately 61.49 by 52 displayed source pixels.

The reader is visually distinct from the integrated cash register, which has an upright pale body, elevated display and broad drawer. The barcode is a black striped code on an orange carton. Shared keypad/receipt cues do not remove the observed silhouette distinction.

The selected-reader state changes the card fill while preserving the entire reader silhouette and full source opacity. Reader-focused and register-focused matched states show actual pair-colored fills, numbered picture badges and connecting lines; the reader remains distinguishable in both focused and settled states.
Card-reader and cash-register labels fit on two lines without clipping. The matched picture badge sits beside the reader silhouette rather than covering its primary card/keypad cues.

The artwork is more saturated and flatter than the register, but the common three-quarter view and complete isolated-object silhouette remain coherent enough for this scoped native comparison. It contains no frightening imagery, merchant branding, readable account data or operational instructions.

brief_decision.brief: Show a compact bank-card payment reader with a plain card close to the reader, a small screen, a keypad and a secondary receipt. Keep the compact device dominant. Exclude a full cash drawer, merchant branding, readable account numbers, PIN entry and operating instructions. The picture does not claim a particular card-reading method or a completed payment.
brief_decision.reason: The depicted device and nearby card support the broad payment-reader noun sense. No hand, contactless symbol, specific reading action, or completed-payment result is depicted; the original contactless-area requirement is not visually established.

technical_limit: The first native attempt retained two strict RGBA comparison failures for the existing barcode and shopping-basket reference images. Candidate and register pixel comparisons passed. This visual record neither resolves nor suppresses those failures.
